statement:
I'll look up the payment record first.
The record shows an active Fitline renewal charge, but since Tomas cancelled this membership in writing on 3 July and the club confirmed the cancellation by email, this charge is not owed and I will refuse it.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer asserts the record's "active, renewing" status is incorrect given the confirmed cancellation: "this charge is not owed and I will refuse it."
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
